ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The 2022 Winter Olympics will open in Beijing on February 4th. As shown in the figure is a schematic diagram of the curling competition venue for the Winter Olympics. The left side is the throwing area, the right side is the circular base camp, and AB is the throwing line. During the competition, there is an opponent's curling stone near the center of the circular base camp. The curling team adopts the "sticking strategy," which means making their own curling stone just touch the opponent's curling stone without colliding. The athlete slides the curling stone from the throwing line AB towards the center of the circular base camp with an initial velocity of $v_{0}=2\mathrm{m/s}$. It is known that the distance from the opponent's curling stone to the AB line is $30\mathsf{m}$, and the kinetic friction coefficient between the curling stone and the ice surface is $\mu_{1}=0.008$. If the ice surface is brushed, the kinetic friction coefficient is reduced to $\mu_{2}=0.004$, and $g$ is taken as $10\mathsf{m}/\mathsf{s}^{2}$.

1. If the athlete does not use a brush to sweep the ice surface, find the maximum time the curling stone can slide.
2. To make the "sticky pot tactic" successful, it is required that the athlete brushes the ice surface with a specific distance.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a horizontal curling track. On the left side there is a vertical throwing line AB. The curling stone moves to the right from near AB along the dashed line, and the arrow marks the initial velocity v0. On the right side is a circular house, and near the house there is a black curling stone representing the opponent's curling stone; the horizontal distance from AB to the position of this curling stone is marked as 30 m. Reasoning: Given v0=2 m/s, μ1=0.008, μ2=0.004, g=10 m/s^2. 1. When not sweeping the ice, the curling stone is only decelerated by kinetic friction, and the magnitude of the acceleration is a1=μ1g=0.008×10=0.08 m/s^2. The maximum sliding time is the time for the speed to decrease from 2 m/s to 0: tmax=v0/a1=2/0.08=25 s. 2. To achieve the "freeze strategy," when the curling stone reaches the opponent's curling stone, it should just stop, that is, all the initial kinetic energy is consumed by the work done by friction over the 30 m path. Let the sweeping distance be x, then the unswept distance is 30-x. Write the energy equation per unit mass: v0^2/2=μ2gx+μ1g(30-x). Substitute the data: 2^2/2=0.004×10x+0.008×10(30-x), that is, 2=0.04x+0.08(30-x)=2.4-0.04x, solving gives x=10 m. Final answer: 1. 25 s; 2. 10 m.
